subject: Automated Response
author: ZombieTron
body:
This is the automated response you will get from emailing: 

Thanks for sending us your comments on Xbox 360 backward compatibility.  We've just received your email.  While we may not have time to directly respond to your email - we value your input and appreciate your taking the time to send us your thoughts. 

If you haven’t already done so, please read the backwards compatibility FAQ at http://www.xbox.com/games/backwardscompatibilityfaq.htm which contains answers to many commonly asked questions. 

Sincerely -
Xbox 

How hard is it to write a sentence saying you want Burnout 2 to be added to the BC list??? Boot you are UBER LAZY!! 😠

--- The Original and the Best ---

subject: Burnout 2: Point of Impact
author: Xandu
body:
I have previously added Burnout 2: Point of Impact to the Backwards Compatibility thread in the "XBox 360 Games" Forum. Today I also sent the mail to backcomp@microsoft.com.  With enough requests we should be able to get this game playable on the Xbox 360!

-- The Creator --
